newsitem.title: USA: Alanis Morissette is top-selling female singer.
newsitem.headline: Alanis Morissette is top-selling female singer.

text.p: Canada's Alanis Morissette became the all-time top-selling female vocalist in the United States when her debut album was certified at 13 million copies sold, a music industry trade group said Wednesday.

The Recording Industry Association of America said Morissette's "Jagged Little Pill" beat out Whitney Houston's "Whitney Houston," which currently stands at 12 million copies sold in the United States, for the top spot among women.

Morissette beat out several other veteran female singers in the process, including Carole King, whose 1971 "Tapestry" has sold 10 million copies, and Madonna, whose 1984 "Like a Virgin" has posted 9 million in sales thus far, the RIAA said.

Since its release in 1995, "Jagged Little Pill" also climbed the ladder of leading all-time debut albums, tying for third behind Boston's "Boston," which has sold 15 million copies since its release in 1976, and Hootie & the Blowfish's 1994 "Cracked Rear View," with 14 million in U.S. sales.
Tied for third with Morissette is Guns 'N Roses, whose 1987 debut "Appetite for Destruction" has also posted 13 million copies sold in America.
